text:
Rina S: Quick report — onboarding sample-app hit a weird 400 from /rerank during a smoke run. Error: "embedding.length mismatch" but payload looked fine locally.
Tom B: any repro logs?
Rina S: yes. We use the streamBatch helper (node) that yields Buffer.subarray slices to avoid copies. When an auth refresh triggers a retry the same slice sometimes points to a mutated backing buffer and one vector ends up one element short (1535/1536). API returns generic embedding.length mismatch.
Yusuf H: ugh. Stream helpers + retry + buffer views = classic mutation race. Python sample-app (lists/copies) never hit it. Which node-sdk?
Rina S: node-sdk@0.10.0 in dev branch. Minimal repro snippet:
```js
const it = streamBatch(vecs, 8)
for await (const batch of it) {
  sendRerank(batch) // sendRerank may enqueue request on 401 and re-use `batch`
}
```
Tom B: two fixes: 1) copy before enqueue in sendRerank, 2) update streamBatch to optionally return copies when RETRY_SAFE=1. Which do you prefer?
Rina S: prefer middleware fix so all callers are safe. Short term I'll patch sample-app to copy in enqueue to unstick onboards.
SDK Bot: Created issue sdk/node#1789: "retry-middleware: clone request body to avoid Buffer view mutation". Assigned to @Tom B.
Yusuf H: another subtle thing we noticed — rerank responses reorder items when client dedupe is turned off and the server does internal dedupe. That can make scores align to different original IDs and confuse caller code that assumes stable ordering. We saw a tiny parity mismatch between node and python clients because the node helper reorders results into place by identity which relied on stable response ordering.
Tom B: good catch. Server already has an option to return an ordering map when dedupe occurs; we should enable and consume it. Platform APIs, can you return an explicit ordering array in the response when dedupe runs? Something like: `ordering: [orig_index -> response_index]` or `input_to_output_map`?
Platform APIs: We can add `input_to_output_map` as an optional field in the rerank response when dedupe is applied. Will keep backward compatibility and document in API change notes.
Rina S: test plan: 1) patch sample-app to copy buffers on enqueue (hotfix), 2) add retry-middleware deep-copy in node-sdk (medium), 3) update streamBatch docs + opt-in copy flag (opt-out default to keep perf), 4) consume `input_to_output_map` in node/pysample so both libs reorder safely.
Tom B: I'll open PRs for middleware + sample-app hotfix and add an E2E that simulates 401->retry + server-side dedupe.
Yusuf H: small UX ask for API errors: please include the failing batch index and the expected/got dims in the error body. Current single-line message slows debugging.
Platform APIs: Noted. We'll add `batch_index`, `expected_dim`, `got_dim` fields to the embedding.error object in the next patch release. SDKs should ignore unknown fields gracefully.
Rina S: hotfix merged to staging, smoke tests now pass. Leaving a note in onboarding README about avoiding Buffer.subarray if requests may be retried. Thanks! :tada:
